advisories.title: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
advisories.reason: All three advisories are parse-time. office-text-extractor only calls js-yaml's dump() to format spreadsheet rows. Electron's app-builder-lib parses our own build config at build time. The sandbox-yaml pack bundles its own copy into the QuickJS guest, where the run's CPU timeout bounds a quadratic parse.

advisories.title: ip SSRF improper categorization in isPublic
advisories.reason: Optional dependency of werift via node-av, used for ICE candidates. NodeTool's SSRF checks (safeFetch) do not use ip.isPublic.

advisories.title: Happy DOM: Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33943: unsanitized import alias leads to host code execution
advisories.reason: Pulled in by @puckeditor/core through @tiptap/html. The web app is a Vite browser build, which resolves @tiptap/html to its browser entry with the real DOM, so happy-dom is not in the shipped bundle; Puck's own dist never imports it. Elsewhere it is vitest's test environment. Fix needs @puckeditor/core 0.24, which moves happy-dom to 21.

advisories.title: Tiptap: Quadratic ReDoS in block and inline Markdown attribute parsing
advisories.reason: Pulled in by @puckeditor/core for the app builder's rich-text fields. ReDoS in Markdown attribute parsing affects the editing user's own tab. The fix needs the whole @tiptap family moved together (core 3.31 pins @tiptap/pm 3.31), which Puck must allow.

advisories.title: MapLibre GL JS: XSS Sanitizer Bypass in DOM.sanitize() via Live NamedNodeMap Removal Skip
advisories.reason: Reached through plotly.js map traces in the web app. Reachability of MapLibre's DOM.sanitize from Plotly figure data is not traced. Fix needs plotly.js 4 (major). Follow-up: trace or upgrade.

advisories.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
advisories.reason: Reachable in principle: API routes validate request bodies with zod, bounded only by Fastify's 100 MB bodyLimit. The fix is zod 4.6, but 4.6 changes z.toJSONSchema output: scalar unions become type arrays, which strict Ajv rejects without allowUnionTypes. That alters the published SDK v1 schemas and the game and preset schemas, so the upgrade needs its own change with a schema compatibility decision.

advisories.title: LinkifyIt#match scan loop has quadratic algorithmic complexity
advisories.reason: markdown-it link detection in chat rendering. Quadratic scans on hostile text slow only the device rendering that message. No fixed release yet.

advisories.title: Cross-site Scripting in Prism
advisories.reason: Syntax highlighting in chat through react-native-syntax-highlighter. Output renders as React Native Text, with no DOM, so the XSS advisories do not apply. The ReDoS affects only the user's own device. No fix in the Prism 1 line that the highlighter accepts.

advisories.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
advisories.reason: Used by Metro, the bundler, on our own assets at build time. Not shipped in the app. Fix needs a Metro release that moves past image-size ^1.
